name: Location table
reader_question: Which sites sit in which jurisdiction, at what stage and status, with what stated capacity?
relationship: Sites grouped by jurisdiction; stage, status and capacity are attributes, not positions.
use_when: The reader needs to find a site and read its status, and no claim depends on geographic distance
Capacity is stated per site in its own unit
avoid_when: The point is spatial clustering or proximity and the source supplies sound coordinates — commission a real map
Capacity must be summed across units — it cannot be; use a single-unit chart

data_contract.notes: Stated capacity in its own unit; null renders as Not stated

units: Each row carries its own capacity unit; no total is computed or shown.

editable: Native table: rows, group header rows, status text, fills

table_alternative: The pattern is itself the table.
variations: Add a column for co-located organisations
limitations: Ten sites is the legible limit on one slide

excluded_alternatives.reason: Decorative when no claim depends on position, and implies a common capacity scale across units
Colours area for a measure the sources state per site
